name: rowIQRs
title: Estimates the interquartile range for each row in a matrix

origin.description: Estimates of the interquartile range for each row (column) in a matrix.
origin.usage:
rowIQRs(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE, ...,
  useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An integer, numeric, or logical N by K matrix.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.
Additional arguments passed to rowQuantiles, including type, digits, and fuzz.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: The value is the 0.75 row quantile minus the 0.25 row quantile. Unlike stats::IQR, a missing value with na.rm FALSE returns NA_real_ rather than an error.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length N, one interquartile range per selected row.

translation.description: Estimates the interquartile range for each row in a matrix.
translation.usage:
rowIQRs(x, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False, use_names=True, type=7,
  digits=7, fuzz=None)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An N by K array. Axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include. None uses every column.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If true, missing values are dropped before the two quantiles. Otherwise a row with a missing value is nan.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: If true, .names carries the row names. An array without row names stays unnamed.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Quantile type passed to rowQuantiles. The default is 7.

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Accepted because rowQuantiles checks it when names are requested. The range itself has no percentage names.

arguments.name: fuzz
arguments.text: Passed through to the quantile estimator.

translation.details: Calls rowQuantiles at 0.25 and 0.75 with drop false, then subtracts the first column from the second. An integer quantile matrix that was never filled is all of R's integer NA, and the difference stays that sentinel.
translation.value: A one-dimensional array of length equal to the selected rows. Calculated ranges are float64. An empty integer margin with type other than 7 is int32 filled with -2147483648.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowiqrs import rowIQRs

rowIQRs(np.arange(1, 13).reshape((4, 3), order="F"))
